zh.lead: 今天最大的产品消息：OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol，即日起在 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 向 Plus、Pro、Enterprise 与 Edu 用户开放。Astra 主打高难度专业与科研任务，Sol 面向日常工作与智能体；API 上 Astra 的输入/输出定价较 GPT-6 Astra 下调 20%。

important.title: 重要消息
items: OpenAI 于北京时间今天凌晨宣布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol 上线。Astra 在 Agents’ Last Exam 上比 GPT-6 Astra 高 5.2 分、成本不到三分之一，并称在 Terminal-Bench-Science 与 Vals Science Index 上刷新纪录；Sol 在 Cognition FrontierCode 2.0 上与 Astra 只差 0.5 分，成本约五分之一。Pro 500 可对两个模型使用 Ultrafast；官方首次把 Ultrafast 开放给 Pro 200，先从 Sol 开始。Astra API 为每百万 tokens 输入 8 美元、缓存输入 0.40 美元、输出 40 美元；Sol 维持 2/10 美元。

Google DeepMind 为 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 推出 Antigravity 机器人插件：可从 USB 完成机械臂接入，在 MuJoCo 里用对话搭建仿真，再把同一套控制代码部署到真机。官方称 I2RT YAM 大约 10 分钟完成标定，传送带分拣示例约一小时从白板做到真机。Hydrogen 在 Artificial Analysis Robotics 上得分 58，接近更大的 Argon，并把 Robotics ER 2 的具身推理带进 Gemini 4 主系列。

产品侧，OpenClaw 稳定版更新为 v2026.11.5（约北京时间昨天下午 18:47）：重启后可保留排队消息与最终写入，更新失败可回滚，并改进 Telegram 组件与记忆索引恢复。Grok Bot 官方 changelog 已补到 v1.2.0（与 Homebrew cask 一致），并补登了昨日尚未出现的 1.1.0 说明；1.2.0 重点是机票结果重做和酒店地图。DeepSeek Harness 实验标签推进到 dsh-v0.2.2-rc.4；codex 稳定版到 0.169.1，发行说明写明没有核实过的功能要点。

sections.title: GPT-6.2：专业输出、法律配置与销售插件
sections.body: 官方强调 Astra 在幻灯片、表格和文书上更贴近行业模板。配套的 Astra for Law 是其法律配置，在 Harvey LAB-AA 上满分比例为 20.8%，高于 GPT-6.2 Astra 的 15.0%；Enterprise 客户可通过 Trusted Access 申请。同时推出的 ChatGPT for Sales 带有自有 Sales 插件和 30 多个合作方插件，可把 CRM 与通话记录接进 ChatGPT。同日还有 NATO 网络安全与智利项目稿，此处不展开。

sections.title: DeepMind：Hydrogen 成为机器人工作台
sections.body: 这不是 Hydrogen 本身的首次亮相，而是把它接到 Antigravity 里做成可安装的 Robotics 插件。支持示例包括 I2RT YAM、LeRobot SO-101 和 Franka FR3 Duo。官方演示还包括双臂肥皂店履约和棋类对弈。DeepMind 另发了一则 Hydrogen 把 Google 表格做成像素画的演示，属于趣味展示，不作为今天的产品主线。

sections.title: 产品栏
sections.body: Hermes Agent 稳定版仍为昨日的 v0.23.2，今日仅见新的 canary 标签，完整说明仍要等 v0.24.0。Cursor changelog 自 11/6 的 Voice Chat with Agents 起仍无新条目。Claude / Anthropic 新闻页与官方 X 今日未见可核对的新产品稿。codex 实验线由昨日的 0.171.0-alpha.10 推进到 alpha.12，这些实验标签的说明仍只标版本号。

sections.title: 缺口
sections.body: @karpathy、@AndrewYNg、@AnthropicAI、@claudeai、@AIatMeta / @Meta 近 48 小时无高信号原创。关注列表无 DeepSeek 一手 X。OpenAI 新闻页直接抓取仍为 403，改以官方 RSS 与已核对文章为准。港股周三早间尚未开盘，回退周二收盘。Open-Meteo 空气预报仅至 11/22，且 US AQI 字段与 PM 不一致，今日改以 PM 为主。水木帖文页出现游客验证码，部分新帖只保留标题与链接。CursorBench 较昨日无更新。

en.lead: Today’s biggest product news: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, available starting today in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Edu users. Astra is the frontier model for hard professional and scientific work; Sol is the everyday and agentic model. Astra’s API input/output prices are 20% lower than GPT-6 Astra.

important.title: Key updates
items: OpenAI announced GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol in the early hours of Asia/Shanghai today. On Agents’ Last Exam, Astra scores 5.2 points above GPT-6 Astra at less than one-third the cost, and OpenAI says it also sets new highs on Terminal-Bench-Science and the Vals Science Index. On Cognition’s FrontierCode 2.0, Sol comes within 0.5 points of Astra at about one-fifth the cost. Pro 500 can use Ultrafast with either model; Ultrafast is being extended to Pro 200 for the first time, starting with Sol. Astra API pricing is $8 input / $0.40 cached input / $40 output per million tokens; Sol keeps GPT-6.1 Sol’s $2 / $10 prices.

Google DeepMind launched a Robotics plugin for Antigravity with Gemini 4 Hydrogen: plug in a supported arm over USB, build a MuJoCo scene in chat, and deploy the same controller to hardware. Official examples include bringing up an I2RT YAM in about 10 minutes and going from a whiteboard sketch to a live conveyor sorter in about an hour. Hydrogen scores 58 on Artificial Analysis Robotics, close to the larger Argon, and brings Gemini Robotics ER 2’s embodied reasoning into the main Gemini 4 line.

On the product side, OpenClaw stable moved to v2026.11.5 (about 18:47 Asia/Shanghai yesterday): queued messages and final writes survive a Gateway restart, failed updates can roll back, and Telegram widgets and memory-index recovery improved. The official Grok Bot changelog has now caught up to v1.2.0 (matching the Homebrew cask) and also posted the 1.1.0 notes that were still missing yesterday; 1.2.0 focuses on a redesigned flight-results view and hotel maps. DeepSeek Harness’s experimental tag moved to dsh-v0.2.2-rc.4; Codex stable is 0.169.1, whose notes say there are no verified release highlights.

sections.title: GPT-6.2: professional output, law, and sales
sections.body: OpenAI says Astra follows professional templates more closely for slides, spreadsheets, and documents, with less generic filler. Astra for Law is a GPT-6.2 Astra configuration with an expanded legal search index; it earned full credit on 20.8% of Harvey LAB-AA assignments, ahead of GPT-6.2 Astra at 15.0%. ChatGPT Enterprise customers can request access through Trusted Access. OpenAI also launched ChatGPT for Sales: a first-party Sales plugin plus more than 30 partner plugins that bring CRM, outreach, and call notes into ChatGPT, including for the always-on dot assistant. Same-day posts on NATO cyber defense and OpenAI for Chile are noted but not expanded here.

sections.title: DeepMind: Hydrogen as a robotics workbench
sections.body: This is not Hydrogen’s first appearance, but a Robotics plugin that turns Antigravity into a workbench. Supported examples include the I2RT YAM, LeRobot SO-101, and Franka FR3 Duo. Official demos also include a dual-arm soap-shop fulfillment flow and chess. A separate DeepMind post shows Hydrogen turning Google Sheets into pixel art; that is a fun demo, not today’s product lead.

sections.title: Product desk
sections.body: Hermes Agent stable remains yesterday’s v0.23.2, with only a new canary tag today; full curated notes still wait for v0.24.0. Cursor’s changelog still has no entry after Voice Chat with Agents on November 6. No verifiable new Claude or Anthropic product post was found on the newsroom or official X today. Codex’s experimental line moved from yesterday’s 0.171.0-alpha.10 to alpha.12; those prerelease notes still name the version only.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.body: No high-signal originals in the past 48 hours from @karpathy, @AndrewYNg, @AnthropicAI, @claudeai, or @AIatMeta / @Meta. The follow list has no first-party DeepSeek X account. Direct fetches of OpenAI’s news HTML still return 403, so official RSS and checked articles are used instead. The HK cash market had not opened at 08:30, so the quote is Tuesday’s close. Open-Meteo’s air forecast runs only through 11/22, and its US AQI field is inconsistent with the co-reported PM readings, so PM is used as the main air call. The Newsmth Child Education index was retrieved from a fallback endpoint, but article pages presented a guest captcha, so some new threads keep title and link only, with no invented summaries. CursorBench is unchanged versus yesterday.

alphaxivTop3.title: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters
alphaxivTop3.authors: Ruixi Yu, Dairu Liu, Xuchuan Chen, Zekun Qi, Zekai Li, Zhuo Cao et al.

summary.zh: 提出将视觉-语言-动作模型扩到 5520 亿参数的 ScaleVLA。作者认为前沿 VLM（文中提到 GPT-6 Astra）已能用于机器人控制，并讨论大规模预训练如何把这种能力带进 VLA。今日居 alphaXiv 热门第 1，替换了昨日的视觉编码论文。
summary.en: ScaleVLA scales vision-language-action models to 552 billion parameters. The authors argue that frontier VLMs (the abstract mentions GPT-6 Astra) already help with robot control, and discuss how large-scale pretraining can carry that into VLAs. It is alphaXiv’s #1 today, replacing yesterday’s vision-encoding paper.

alphaxivTop3.title: Stream of Belief: Eliciting Collective Intelligence through Latent Belief Dynamics
alphaxivTop3.authors: Yu Yao, Jiayi Dong, Yilun Du

summary.zh: 把多智能体推理看成潜在信念动力学的集体均衡，提出 Stream of Belief（SoB）：智能体维护并交换隐含信念，而不是只靠外显对话对齐。今日新上榜第 2。
summary.en: Treats multi-agent reasoning as seeking a collective equilibrium of latent belief dynamics, and introduces Stream of Belief (SoB), in which agents maintain and exchange implicit beliefs rather than aligning only through overt dialogue. New at #2 today.

alphaxivTop3.title: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models
alphaxivTop3.authors: K2 Team, Zhengzhong Liu, Haonan Li, Xuezhe Ma, Alexander Moreno, Subham Sekhar Sahoo et al.

summary.zh: 介绍 K2-Horizon：一套完全开源的语言模型家族，从 0.9B 稠密模型到 375B-A23B MoE，面向通用推理和智能体任务（数学与软件等）。今日新上榜第 3。昨日第 2 的仿真机器人训练论文现位于第 7。
summary.en: Introduces K2-Horizon, a fully open fleet of language models from a 0.9B dense model to a 375B-A23B MoE, built for general-purpose reasoning and agentic work in math and software. New at #3 today. Yesterday’s #2 paper on training robot-use agents in simulation now sits at #7.

title.zh: 英语1年记录一下
title.en: 英语1年记录一下

summary.zh: 楼主回顾孩子二年级一年的英语自学：从课内听写不会，经词汇冷启动、精读和大量听读，一路摸索方法。跟帖祝贺进展，并纠正“重复若干次就能记住”“听力词汇必须大于阅读词汇”等说法。今日回复已增至 26（昨日 5），末页因游客验证未能刷新，摘要依据此前可见内容，不编造新增跟帖。
summary.en: The OP recaps a year of self-directed English for a second-grader, from failing in-class dictation to a cold-start vocabulary phase, close reading, and a lot of listening and reading. Replies congratulate the progress and push back on claims such as a fixed number of repetitions making a word stick, or that listening vocabulary must exceed reading vocabulary. Replies are now 26 (yesterday 5); today’s last page could not be refreshed because of a guest captcha, so the summary follows previously visible posts and does not invent new replies.

title.zh: 话多的小孩儿是不是ADHD？
title.en: 话多的小孩儿是不是ADHD？

summary.zh: 楼主说低年级孩子话多到嗓子沙哑，老师多次反馈上课不专注，但记忆力好、阅读时能安静，怀疑是不是多动症。跟帖提醒记忆力好往往不像典型 ADHD，是否确诊应就医，也有人担心长大后社交边界会成问题。
summary.en: The OP describes a lower-grade child who talks until hoarse and is often inattentive in class, yet has a strong memory and can read quietly, and wonders about ADHD. Replies note that a good memory is not typical of ADHD, suggest seeing a clinician for a real assessment, and some worry about social boundaries later on.

title.zh: 我始终下不了决心对孩子要求太严
title.en: 我始终下不了决心对孩子要求太严

summary.zh: 楼主对比自己当年，觉得孩子初中作息更累：六点半起床、七点一刻早读，晚上十点后才睡，因此下不了决心再加码要求。跟帖多数强调先保证睡眠和提高效率，能学成什么样算什么样，也有人认为这取决于孩子精力。今日回复已增至 14（昨日 8），末页因游客验证未能刷新，摘要依据此前可见内容，不编造新增跟帖。
summary.en: Comparing with their own junior-high years, the OP feels the child’s schedule is harder: up at 6:30, morning reading at 7:15, and bed after 10 p.m., so they cannot bring themselves to demand more. Most replies stress protecting sleep and working more efficiently, accepting whatever result follows; some say it depends on the child’s energy. Replies are now 14 (yesterday 8); today’s last page could not be refreshed because of a guest captcha, so the summary follows previously visible posts and does not invent new replies.

title.zh: 初三家长求助：孩子偷偷下载违规软件，怎么沟通和处理
title.en: A grade-9 parent asks how to handle a child secretly downloading prohibited software

summary.zh: 初三家长给孩子设了手机管控后，发现孩子另用旧手机下载了违规软件，已沟通并征求怎么处理。跟帖多数认为不必过度上纲，更应把重点放在沟通、边界和青春期教育上。
summary.en: After setting phone restrictions, a parent of a ninth-grader found the child using an old phone to download prohibited software, and asks how to handle it. Most replies counsel against overreacting and emphasize communication, boundaries, and ordinary adolescent education.

title.zh: 整理错题什么app好用？
title.en: 整理错题什么app好用？

summary.zh: 楼主求识别、复原效果好、好整理的错题 App。跟帖有人推荐试卷宝、超级错题本，也有人担心伤视力，主张用最原始的办法、尽量让孩子自己整理。今日回复已增至 19（昨日 13），末页因游客验证未能刷新，摘要依据此前可见内容，不编造新增跟帖。
summary.en: The OP asks for an error-notebook app with reliable recognition and easy organization. Some recommend specific apps, while others worry about eye strain and prefer analog methods, ideally with the student doing the organizing. Replies are now 19 (yesterday 13); today’s last page could not be refreshed because of a guest captcha, so the summary follows previously visible posts and does not invent new replies.

title.zh: 如果不分班，学霸就不能是学霸了？
title.en: 如果不分班，学霸就不能是学霸了？

summary.zh: 旧帖今日又被顶起。楼主认为平行分班并不会让学霸消失，分班更多是固化优势、加剧内卷。跟帖补充班风和纪律往往比单纯按成绩分班更影响发挥，也有人认为分层教学对基础薄弱的学生有用。
summary.en: This older thread was bumped again today. The OP says mixed classes do not stop high achievers from excelling, and tracking mostly hardens early advantages. Replies add that classroom climate and discipline often matter more than score-based tracking, though some argue grouped teaching can help weaker students.

title.zh: 目前二年级，怎么练英语口语？担心跟爸妈一样，虽然6级都过了，
title.en: 目前二年级，怎么练英语口语？担心跟爸妈一样，虽然6级都过了，

summary.zh: 楼主孩子二年级，读写和词汇已有基础，想练口语，担心以后像父母一样过了六级却开不了口。旧帖今日又有人求口语 App，也有人愿意提供绘本/口语测试账号。
summary.en: The OP’s second-grader already has some reading, writing, and vocabulary, and the parent wants to build speaking so the child does not end up like CET-6 passers who still cannot talk. The older thread was bumped today with requests for speaking apps and an offer of a test account.

text.zh: 今日重心（周三去敏）：工作日继续推进生产与架构事项，重点包括主要功能迁移情况梳理（含声纹相关）并准备整体汇报，同时继续知识库文档迁移与分享倡议，以及按季度审视供应商管理风险。学习侧继续技术文章阅读，并安排安全架构课（信任边界）、harness 工程与 RSI/DDD，以及 pstack 方向的研究；实体硬件上的语音问答按计划推进。通识课仍在进行中。
text.en: Wednesday focus (sanitized): on the work side, continue production and architecture items, especially a review of major feature migration (including voiceprint-related work) and a planned overall briefing, along with the knowledge-base document migration and sharing effort, and a quarterly look at vendor-management risk. On the learning side, keep up with technical reading, and schedule the security-architecture lesson on trust boundaries, harness engineering and RSI/DDD, plus pstack study; hardware voice-QA work continues as planned. The general-education course is still in progress.
